adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the table is created with just host/category_id/timestamps and no index or uniqueness constraint on host. Meanwhile EmbeddableHost.record_for_host does `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first`, which (without a functional index on lower(host) or a normalized stored value plus index) will require scanning to find matches as the table grows. Also, the diff adds no `validates_uniqueness_of :host` or DB-level unique index, so duplicate hosts are allowed, though this doesn't necessarily break correctness since `.first` is used.
